changesProposed.name: Commonwealth Fusion Systems

verified.name: Commonwealth Fusion Systems
verified.description: American fusion power company developing compact tokamak fusion reactors using high-temperature superconducting magnets. Founded as a spin-off from MIT, the company is building the SPARC demonstration tokamak and plans to construct a commercial fusion power plant.
verified.notes: Founded in 2018 as spin-off from MIT Plasma Science and Fusion Center. Series B2 funding of $863M announced in August 2025. Multiple rounds of funding documented: $50M (2018), $115M Series A (2019), $84M Series A2 (2020), $1.8B Series B (November 2021). Bob Mumgaard is CEO. SPARC tokamak construction began December 2021 in Devens, MA. Company plans first commercial fusion power plant in Virginia by early 2030s.
